unit_of_observation: one fictional recruited student at one of three campus counseling sites
recruitment: fixed synthetic recruited sample of 1200 Cedar, 720 Lake, and 480 Ridge students; not a probability sample from a real population
assignment_mechanism: independent Bernoulli(0.50) workshop-offer assignment within each site
target_estimand: target-standardized intention-to-treat effect of workshop_offer for a fixed target composition of 25% Cedar, 35% Lake, and 40% Ridge
warning: Randomization identifies offer effects in the fictional recruited sample. Target transport and treatment-receipt effects require additional assumptions.
causal_structure: attendance response and structural effects are hidden generator properties

structural_equations.would_attend_if_offered: Bernoulli(logit_inverse(site logit - 0.025*(baseline_stress-50))) from a latent uniform draw
structural_equations.site_attendance_effect: Cedar 2.0; Lake 3.5; Ridge 5.0 points, hidden from the analyst

missing_value_code: none; all six CSV fields are complete

variables.name: baseline_stress
variables.role: pre-assignment precision covariate and possible effect modifier

site_or_time_variables: three fictional sites; one baseline and one immediate outcome period
